children.value: I was skeptical that a simple meditation could have much impact, but with regular practice I found myself feeling calm in previously stressful situations and less identified with my thoughts and emotions.

Work situations used to irritate me often, hurting my productivity. After a week of meditation, everything changed. I now handle tasks with ease, experience less friction, and find genuine joy in my work.
The app is designed with a clear focus on meditation and looking inward. I appreciate its simplicity—no unnecessary features, offering just what I need: meditation, wisdom, and Sadhguru's presence.
My friend suggested this app. Been doing this for 2 weeks. No big transformation but my mind feels lighter. As a working professional, this has helped me be more focused and calm and less stressed.
